text:
nina.s: Quick update  AureliaHealth signed a renewal and accepted our AWS Marketplace ISV listing for the Private connector. Deal = ~$295k ARR. They consolidated multiple model endpoints into a single Private cluster and enabled KMS + SSO. Big thanks to @carlos_rm and @rita.ops for the lift. :tada:

carlos_rm: Migration highlights: moved from self-hosted GPUs to Redwood Private, applied int4 quant and prefix caching. Early metrics: ~33% token-cost reduction, ~19% P95 latency improvement. Adding perf charts to the case draft.

evan_sales: Customer asked for a short joint quote for the PR. Suggested quote: "Redwood helped us scale secure inference without the ops overhead." Sending to customer to approve. cc @legal-bot

rita.ops: Runbook and rollback script posted: https://notion.redwood/Aurelia-migration. Canary traffic 5/25/70 over 48h, no rollbacks. Small transient: PVC mount error in stage 1 (~0.6% pods) fixed by bumping mountProbe to 40s. Logged root cause and fix.

legal-bot: Marketplace appendix reviewed; requested one small DPA tweak on logs retention. Will upload signed addendum by EOD Tue.

marketplace-bot: AWS listing live in staging; please verify screenshots and support contact.

aurelia-bot: Customer-approved quote: "With Redwood we moved sensitive inference into production quickly and securely."  AureliaHead of Data Science

nina.s: Marketing: please coordinate a joint announcement next Wed after legal sign-off. Ops: prepare a 1-slide postmortem-lite with migration lessons. Sales: capture renewal playbook entry.

carlos_rm: Action items for eng-ml: publish quant profile and prefix-cache recipe in Redwood Optimize. I'll add a short "how we got 33%" writeup.

eran_sales: Celebratory note: small toast in the kitchen Friday 4pm. :clinking_glasses:

press-bot: PR draft created (PR-5102). Added metric placeholders and quote.

nina.s: Thanks team  uploading the case draft: https://notion.redwood/Aurelia-case-draft. Please add any customer-facing one-line metrics so marketing can finalize the PR.

rita.ops: I'll publish the migration notes and the PVC workaround to ops-runbook today.

marketplace-bot: Scheduled production publish for the marketplace listing on 2025-04-07T17:00:00Z (task PR-5102).

nina.s: Closing loop: once legal and customer approve logo + quote, marketing will publish. Great job everyone!
